\begin{example} \end{example}[Asymptotic ratios of cylinders, Bryant solitons, and cones] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0107 ↗ def:chow-iii-asymptotic-ratios 1. ch19:19.16–19.18\group Asymptotic Geometry

Closed-factor cylinders have $\operatorname {AVR}=0$; the Bryant soliton has volume growth of order $r^{(n+1)/2}$, $\operatorname {AVR}=0$, and $\operatorname {ASCR}=\infty $. A cone $dr^2+r^2k$ over $(P^{n-1},k)$ has \[ \operatorname {AVR}=\frac{\Vol (P,k)}{n\omega _n}>0, \qquad \operatorname {ASCR}<\infty . \] \end{example}
